title: MobileWAM: Bridging World Action Models to Mobile Manipulation with Chain-of-Foresight
summary: World action models (WAMs) built on video generation backbones are a rising recipe for robot learning, yet remain confined to tabletop manipulation. Mobile manipulation demands simultaneous locomotion and whole-body manipulation amid scene-scale dynamics, yet is still dominated by dynamics-blind visual encoders with hand-crafted coordination. We bridge this gap with MobileWAM, a mixture-of-transformers architecture that fuses a pretrained video diffusion transformer with a lightweight action expert through layerwise joint attention, translating internet-scale motion priors into whole-body control. To reconcile the heterogeneous dynamics of moving and manipulating, each feed-forward layer of the action expert becomes a three-expert mixture of shared, locomotion, and manipulation experts, softly routed by the motion intent in the action tokens. To densify supervision, we further propose Chain-of-Foresight (CoF): intermediate representations sequentially predict a chain of future latent chunks, each step conditioned on its predecessor. CoF pairs naturally with our decoupled video--action denoising scheme. At deployment, the WAM serves as a pure current-frame encoder; foresight acts only through gradients, so at inference the foresight chain and video generation are discarded, leaving only policy-level cost. MobileWAM surpasses state-of-the-art mobile manipulation policies on ManiSkill-HAB and fine-tunes to a real ARX Lift2 mobile manipulator across diverse tasks with strong generalization. Code will be released soon.
tldr: MobileWAM extends world action models from tabletop to mobile manipulation using a mixture-of-transformers architecture and a Chain-of-Foresight supervision method, achieving state-of-the-art results on simulated benchmarks and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: MobileWAM 通过混合变换器架构和前瞻链监督方法，将世界动作模型从桌面操作扩展到移动操作，在仿真基准和真实机器人任务上取得了领先成果。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）基于视频生成骨干网络构建，是机器人学习领域的新兴方案，但迄今仍局限于桌面级操作任务。移动操作要求在场景级动态环境中实现同步运动与全身控制，当前主流方法仍依赖手工设计的协调机制与动态盲视视觉编码器。我们通过MobileWAM填补这一空白——该混合变换器架构将预训练视频扩散变换器与轻量级动作专家通过层级联合注意力机制融合，将互联网规模的运动先验转化为全身控制策略。为协调移动与操作任务的异构动态特性，动作专家每个前馈层发展为共享、移动与操作三专家混合结构，通过动作令牌中的运动意图进行软路由。为进一步增强监督信号，我们提出预见链（Chain-of-Foresight, CoF）机制：中间表示序列逐步预测未来潜在块链，每步以前驱结果为条件。CoF与我们解耦的视频-动作去噪方案自然适配。部署时，WAM作为纯当前帧编码器运行；预见仅通过梯度作用，推理阶段舍弃预见链与视频生成，仅保留策略级成本。MobileWAM在ManiSkill-HAB基准上超越现有最先进移动操作策略，并通过微调在真实ARX Lift2移动机械臂上实现多样化任务下的强泛化能力。代码即将开源。

title: Talk2Sensors: 3D Visual Grounding in Autonomous Driving via Sensor-Adaptive Physical Cue Matching
summary: As a key capability for embodied intelligence, 3D visual grounding (3DVG) has been predominantly studied in indoor scenes with RGB-D or point-cloud inputs, while existing outdoor extensions largely rely on monocular images alone. Both settings fall short of real-world outdoor perception, where heterogeneous sensors capture complementary yet distinct physical properties, such as visual texture, 3D geometry, and object kinematics, that are indispensable for flexible and robust query-adaptive grounding but remain under-exploited. To bridge this gap, we introduce Talk2Sensors, the first multi-sensor 3D visual grounding dataset built upon camera, LiDAR, and 4D radar. It contains 8,682 language instructions and 20,558 referred objects, with diverse prompts explicitly aligned with sensor-specific physical cues. Furthermore, we propose TSFormer, a unified Transformer-based framework for language-guided 3D visual grounding in autonomous driving. TSFormer adopts a coarse-to-fine property-aware fusion strategy: the Language-Routed Property Sampler first performs coarse text-conditioned feature retrieval by modulating sensor sampling weights with query-level linguistic cues, while the subsequent Sparse-Preserving Modality Arbiter module conducts fine-grained modality arbitration and text-guided refinement to determine the precise referred spatial location. This design enables dynamic routing of appearance, geometry, and motion cues according to the semantic requirements of each prompt, preventing dense modalities from overwhelming sparse but critical sensor signals. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TSFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks: it improves over the strongest baseline by 8.05 mAP on Talk2Sensors, and transfers to the monocular Mono3DRefer benchmark with 53.05\% Acc@0.5.
tldr: Talk2Sensors introduces the first multi-sensor (camera, LiDAR, 4D radar) 3D visual grounding dataset for autonomous driving and a Transformer-based framework (TSFormer) that adaptively fuses appearance, geometry, and motion cues guided by language queries, achieving SOTA on the new dataset and transferring to a monocular benchmark.
tldr_zh: Talk2Sensors提出了首个面向自动驾驶的多传感器（相机、激光雷达、4D雷达）3D视觉定位数据集，以及一个基于Transformer的框架TSFormer，该框架根据语言查询自适应融合外观、几何和运动线索，在新数据集上达到SOTA并迁移至单目基准。
summary_zh: 作为具身智能的关键能力，3D视觉定位（3DVG）主要在室内场景中基于RGB-D或点云输入进行研究，而现有的室外扩展则大多依赖单目图像。这两种设定均无法满足真实室外感知需求——异构传感器捕获的视觉纹理、3D几何与物体运动学等互补且具有不同物理属性的信息，对实现灵活稳健的查询自适应定位不可或缺，却尚未被充分利用。为填补这一空白，我们提出Talk2Sensors——首个基于相机、激光雷达和4D雷达的多传感器3D视觉定位数据集。该数据集包含8,682条语言指令与20,558个被指代对象，其多样化提示词明确对齐传感器特有的物理线索。此外，我们提出TSFormer——面向自动驾驶中语言引导的3D视觉定位的统一Transformer框架。TSFormer采用从粗到细的属性感知融合策略：语言路由属性采样器首先通过查询级语言线索调制传感器采样权重，实现基于文本的粗粒度特征检索；后续的稀疏保持模态仲裁模块则进行细粒度模态仲裁与文本引导精炼，以确定精确的被指空间位置。该设计能根据每条提示的语义需求动态路由外观、几何与运动线索，防止稠密模态淹没稀疏但关键的可预测信号。大量实验表明，TSFormer在多个基准测试中均达到最优性能：在Talk2Sensors上相比最强基线提升8.05 mAP，并迁移至单目Mono3DRefer基准，实现53.05%的Acc@0.5。

title: Deltoris: Enabling Real-time VLA Inference in Embodied AI via Bit-level Sparsity and Speculative Inference
summary:
Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a key component in embodied AI. Among existing approaches, diffusion-based VLA models achieve superior motion quality and generalization. However, diffusion-based VLA models are compute-intensive and must run at high control frequency, e.g., 50-200 Hz. Thus, it imposes strict latency and energy constraints on edge devices.
  In this work, we present Deltoris, an algorithm-hardware co-design framework for efficient diffusion-based VLA inference. First, we exploit the temporal similarity of consecutive inputs and propose a \textit{temporal-aware bit-sparsity} algorithm that computes only the differences between consecutive inputs, eliminating redundant bit-level operations. To further address the extra off-chip traffic introduced by our algorithm, we propose a \textit{speculative inference} technique, which amortizes data loading across multiple control steps. Lastly, to support these techniques, we co-design a dedicated accelerator with customized 1D systolic bit-serial PE arrays that eliminate PE workload imbalance. Our evaluation shows that Deltoris achieves up to 34.2$\times$ speedup over mobile GPUs and 6.1$\times$ over prior accelerators, while maintaining comparable accuracy.
tldr: Deltoris is an algorithm-hardware co-design framework that enables real-time, energy-efficient inference for diffusion-based VLA models on edge devices using temporal-aware bit-sparsity and speculative inference.
tldr_zh: Deltoris 是一个算法-硬件协同设计框架，通过时间感知的比特稀疏性和推测推理，在边缘设备上实现扩散 VLA 模型的实时、高效推理。
summary_zh:
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为具身人工智能的核心组成部分。在现有方法中，基于扩散的VLA模型展现了卓越的动作质量与泛化能力。然而，这类模型计算密集且需以50-200 Hz的高控制频率运行，因此对边缘设备施加了严格的延迟与能耗约束。

本文提出Deltoris——一种面向高效扩散型VLA推理的算法-硬件协同设计框架。首先，我们利用连续输入之间的时间相似性，提出**时序感知位稀疏性**算法，仅计算相邻输入间的差异项，消除冗余的位级运算。为应对该算法带来的额外片外数据搬运开销，我们进一步提出**推测推理**技术，将数据加载分摊至多个控制步骤中。最后，为支撑上述技术，我们协同设计了专用加速器，其采用定制的一维脉动位串行处理单元阵列，消除了处理单元间的负载不均衡。评估结果表明，与移动GPU相比，Deltoris可实现最高34.2倍加速，较现有加速器提升6.1倍，同时保持相当的精度。

title: SpikingNav: Robust Embodied Navigation with Spiking Neural Policies
summary: Embodied navigation requires an agent to make sequential decisions from egocentric observations in a physical environment. Existing Artificial Neural Network (ANN)-based navigation models have achieved strong performance, yet they often rely on dense computation and may degrade under visual corruptions. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) provide event-driven computation and intrinsic temporal dynamics, which are promising for compact and robust navigation on resource-constrained platforms. However, whether spike-based sensing and policy dynamics can improve robustness in visually rich embodied navigation remains an open problem. This paper proposes SpikingNav, a spiking framework for robust indoor embodied navigation. It contains a Spiking Sensing Encoder (SSE) and a Spiking Policy Network (SPN). The SSE extracts task-conditioned visual features with a spike-based backbone. The SPN maintains a recurrent policy state through membrane integration, thresholding, and spike-triggered reset. In this way, SpikingNav exploits the dynamic properties and spike activations of SNNs to improve navigation performance and robustness. We evaluate SpikingNav on PointNav and ObjectNav under clean observations and visual corruptions. SpikingNav achieves competitive clean performance and stronger robustness with fewer parameters and lower per-step computation than a matched ANN baseline. For instance, SpikingNav improves ObjectNav success from 31.05% to 34.12%, and raises the average success under visual corruptions from 8.45% to 13.71%, demonstrating the benefits of spike-based sensing and policy dynamics. We further validate the deployability of our spike-based sensing method on the Thruster-V2 neuromorphic chip. This physical hardware validation shows that SpikingNav can be instantiated on a real neuromorphic substrate for cyber-physical systems.
tldr: SpikingNav introduces a spiking neural network framework for embodied navigation that achieves robust performance under visual corruptions with fewer parameters and lower computation, validated on a neuromorphic chip.
tldr_zh: SpikingNav 提出了一种脉冲神经网络框架用于具身导航，在视觉干扰下具有更强的鲁棒性，且参数量和计算量更少，并在神经形态芯片上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 具身导航要求智能体在物理环境中基于自我中心观测进行序列化决策。现有基于人工神经网络的导航模型虽已取得优异性能，但通常依赖密集计算且易受视觉干扰影响。脉冲神经网络具备事件驱动计算与内在时序动态特性，为资源受限平台上的轻量化鲁棒导航提供了新思路。然而，基于脉冲的感知与策略动态能否提升高视觉复杂度具身导航任务的鲁棒性仍是开放性问题。本文提出SpikingNav——面向鲁棒室内具身导航的脉冲框架，包含脉冲感知编码器与脉冲策略网络。其中，脉冲感知编码器采用基于脉冲的骨干网络提取任务条件化视觉特征；脉冲策略网络通过膜电位整合、阈值触发与脉冲重置机制维持循环策略状态。由此，SpikingNav利用脉冲神经网络的动态特性与脉冲激活机制提升导航性能与鲁棒性。我们在无干扰及存在视觉干扰场景下对PointNav与ObjectNav任务进行评估。与同构人工神经网络基准相比，SpikingNav在参数更少、单步计算量更低的条件下，实现了相当的无干扰性能与更强的鲁棒性。例如，SpikingNav将ObjectNav成功率从31.05%提升至34.12%，并将视觉干扰下的平均成功率从8.45%提高至13.71%，验证了脉冲感知与策略动态的优势。我们进一步在Thruster-V2神经形态芯片上验证了所提脉冲感知方法的可部署性。该物理硬件实验表明，SpikingNav可在真实神经形态基板上实现信息物理系统应用。

title: BridgeVLA++: A Data-Efficient, Generalizable, and Memory-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Framework for 3D Manipulation
summary: Leveraging pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) to construct vision-language-action (VLA) models has emerged as a promising paradigm for 3D robot manipulation. However, existing 3D VLA methods remain data-hungry, exhibit limited generalization under distribution shifts, and lack explicit memory of past observations. These limitations hinder their application to data-scarce, open-world, and memory-dependent manipulation scenarios. Our previous work, BridgeVLA, improves data efficiency and generalization by preserving the input--output alignment of a pre-trained VLM during 3D action learning: raw point clouds are projected into multi-view images, and intermediate heatmaps are predicted before generating robot actions. In this work, we develop BridgeVLA++ by equipping BridgeVLA with a unified spatio-temporal memory architecture that models persistent spatial context and temporal interaction history. The resulting memory-augmented framework can reason over observation histories while preserving BridgeVLA's data efficiency and generalization capabilities. Extensive experiments show that our framework achieves strong performance on spatial manipulation tasks while exhibiting robust generalization. BridgeVLA++ further achieves state-of-the-art performance on two challenging memory-dependent manipulation benchmarks without sacrificing the data efficiency and generalization of the original BridgeVLA. In addition, BridgeVLA++ performs effectively in bimanual manipulation settings and is validated on an additional real-world robotic platform, demonstrating its scalability across tasks, environments, and robotic platforms. These results establish BridgeVLA++ as a unified 3D vision-language-action framework that simultaneously supports data-efficient learning, robust generalization, and effective memory-aware robot manipulation. Project website: https://bridgevla-plus.github.io/.
tldr: BridgeVLA++ extends the BridgeVLA framework with a unified spatio-temporal memory module that enables memory-aware reasoning while preserving data efficiency and generalization for 3D robot manipulation, achieving state-of-the-art results on memory-dependent benchmarks and bimanual settings.
tldr_zh: BridgeVLA++通过统一的空间-时间记忆模块扩展了BridgeVLA框架，在保持数据效率和泛化能力的同时实现记忆感知推理，在依赖记忆的操作任务和双臂操作中取得了最优结果。
summary_zh: 利用预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）构建视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，已成为三维机器人操作领域一种颇具前景的范式。然而，现有的三维VLA方法仍存在数据需求量大、在分布偏移下泛化能力有限、以及缺乏对过去观测的显式记忆等不足。这些局限性阻碍了它们应用于数据稀缺、开放世界及依赖记忆的操作场景。我们之前的工作BridgeVLA通过保持预训练VLM在三维动作学习过程中的输入-输出对齐，即先将原始点云投影为多视角图像，再在生成机器人动作之前预测中间热力图，从而提升了数据效率与泛化能力。在本工作中，我们开发了BridgeVLA++，为其配备了一种统一的时空记忆架构，用于建模持久的空间上下文与时间交互历史。由此形成的增强记忆框架能够在保留BridgeVLA数据效率与泛化能力的同时，对观测历史进行推理。大量实验表明，我们的框架在空间操作任务中表现出色，并展现出稳健的泛化能力。BridgeVLA++在两项具有挑战性的依赖记忆的操作基准测试中，在不牺牲原始BridgeVLA数据效率与泛化能力的前提下，进一步取得了最先进的性能。此外，BridgeVLA++在双臂操作场景中也表现优异，并在另一款真实世界机器人平台上得到验证，展示了其在任务、环境及机器人平台间的可扩展性。这些成果使BridgeVLA++成为一个统一的三维视觉-语言-动作框架，能够同时支持高效数据学习、稳健泛化以及有效的记忆感知机器人操作。项目网站：https://bridgevla-plus.github.io/。

title: DreamWAM: Beyond RGB Future Prediction for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) learn action-relevant representations by predicting how the observed world will evolve. Most existing WAMs define this future in RGB space, where task-relevant state transitions are entangled with nuisance variations in texture, illumination, background, and viewpoint. We argue that WAMs should explicitly predict action-relevant future state rather than relying on RGB prediction alone. We introduce DreamWAM, which reformulates future prediction as structured world modeling beyond RGB, representing future states through complementary views of appearance, motion, geometry, and semantics. During training, DreamWAM combines joint latent denoising of RGB and motion with lightweight gated residual branches for geometry and semantics. Shared attention between VideoDiT and ActionDiT allows the action branch to learn from these future-state predictions, while all beyond-RGB supervision branches are disabled at inference and deployment remains RGB-only. Across both no-rollout and joint video-action inference, DreamWAM consistently improves the matched RGB-only baselines on LIBERO, from 97.30\% to 98.40\% and from 98.00\% to 98.90\%, respectively. The gains become larger under unseen LIBERO-Plus perturbations, from 51.36\% to 63.44\% and from 69.16\% to 75.47\%. The same robustness extends to real-world manipulation, where DreamWAM attains an average success rate of 74.4\% across unseen changes in lighting, background, and object layout, compared with 55.6\% for Fast-WAM-Joint. These results show that robust world-action learning depends not only on predicting the future, but on representing it in a form that matters for action. The code and models are publicly released at https://github.com/hustvl/DreamWAM.
tldr: DreamWAM improves World Action Models by predicting future states in structured modalities (appearance, motion, geometry, semantics) beyond RGB, boosting robustness and success rates in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: DreamWAM 通过预测未来状态的结构化表示（外观、运动、几何、语义）来改进世界行动模型，超越 RGB 预测，提升了机器人操作的鲁棒性和成功率。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过预测观察世界如何演化来学习与动作相关的表征。现有的大多数WAMs在RGB空间中定义这种未来状态，而在此空间中，任务相关的状态变迁与纹理、光照、背景及视角等无关变量变化相互纠缠。我们认为WAMs应当明确预测与动作相关的未来状态，而非仅依赖RGB预测。我们提出DreamWAM，它将未来预测重新定义为超越RGB的结构化世界建模，通过外观、运动、几何和语义的互补视角表征未来状态。训练过程中，DreamWAM结合RGB与运动的联合潜在去噪，以及用于几何和语义的轻量化门控残差分支。VideoDiT与ActionDiT之间的共享注意力机制使得动作分支能够从这些未来状态预测中学习，而所有超越RGB的监督分支在推理时被禁用，部署阶段仍仅使用RGB。在无展开推断与联合视频-动作推断两种场景下，DreamWAM在LIBERO数据集上分别将匹配的RGB基线结果从97.30%提升至98.40%、从98.00%提升至98.90%。在未见过的LIBERO-Plus扰动下，性能增益更为显著，分别从51.36%提升至63.44%、从69.16%提升至75.47%。这种鲁棒性同样适用于真实世界的操控任务：面对光照、背景和物体布局的未见变化，DreamWAM实现了74.4%的平均成功率，而Fast-WAM-Joint仅为55.6%。这些结果表明，稳健的世界-动作学习不仅取决于预测未来，更取决于以对动作有意义的形式表征未来。代码与模型已开源发布于https://github.com/hustvl/DreamWAM。

title: RORA: Realistic Object Reconstruction with Articulation
summary: Replicating real-world environments into simulation by realistic visual representation like NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as an effective strategy to reduce the sim-to-real gap in robot learning. However, implementing object articulation during the real-to-sim process is still a challenging task. Existing motion tracking or learning based articulation methods shows low success rates on complex kinematic structures having multiple joints. Furthermore, those methods require scan of dynamic motion of objects, which makes reconstruction process much complicated. In this work, we propose the first end-to-end pipeline that reconstructs simulation-ready assets with accurate articulation from a single static object video input through suggestion based human-in-the-loop process. Our approach exports a hybrid representation combining 3DGS for photorealistic rendering and mesh-based geometry for physical interaction. In the reconstruction process, our pipeline performs convex decomposition followed by user grouping for intuitive part segmentation, subsequently binding 3D Gaussians to the corresponding mesh parts. An Automatic Joint Suggestion Algorithm then calculates candidate joint axes from local boundary geometries and presents them to users for efficient articulated asset reconstruction. We have shown that our method achieves precise articulation results on partnet-mobility-v0 dataset and real objects. Additionally we presented a potential usage of our framework on robot learning, deploying the reconstructed assets in Unreal Engine and NVIDIA Isaac Sim, demonstrating real-time dexterous hand manipulation tasks.
tldr: RORA is an end-to-end pipeline that reconstructs articulated objects from a single static video, combining 3DGS and mesh for photorealistic rendering and physical interaction, with a human-in-the-loop joint suggestion algorithm, enabling deployment in robot simulators.
tldr_zh: RORA 是一个端到端管线，能从单段静态视频重建带关节的物体，结合 3DGS 和网格以实现逼真渲染与物理交互，并通过人机协同的关节建议算法，支持在机器人仿真器中部署。
summary_zh: 将真实世界环境通过NeRF和3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）等逼真视觉表征复现到仿真中，已成为减少机器人学习中间隙-实差距的有效策略。然而，在真实到仿真过程中实现物体关节运动仍是一项具有挑战性的任务。现有基于运动跟踪或学习的关节运动方法在处理具有多个关节的复杂运动学结构时成功率较低。此外，这些方法需要扫描物体的动态运动过程，使得重建流程更加复杂。在本工作中，我们提出了首个端到端流水线，通过基于建议的人机交互流程，仅从单个静态物体视频输入即可重建具有精确关节运动、可直接用于仿真的资产。我们的方法导出了混合表征，结合了用于逼真渲染的3DGS和用于物理交互的网格几何体。在重建过程中，我们的流水线先执行凸分解，随后通过用户分组实现直观的部件分割，进而将3D高斯绑定到对应的网格部件上。接着，一种自动关节建议算法从局部边界几何体中计算出候选关节轴，并将其呈现给用户，以实现高效的关节运动资产重建。我们证明了该方法在partnet-mobility-v0数据集和真实物体上均能获得精确的关节运动结果。此外，我们还展示了该框架在机器人学习中的潜在应用，在虚幻引擎和NVIDIA Isaac Sim中部署了重建资产，演示了实时灵巧手操作任务。

title: Deliberate Before You Fly: Vision-Guided Spatial Deliberation for UAV See-and-Reach Navigation
summary: UAV see-and-reach navigation requires an aerial agent to approach a language-specified target visible in its initial view and stop reliably near it. Existing methods typically map vision-language representations directly to action outputs without explicitly modeling intermediate fine-grained spatial decisions. This direct mapping causes semantic-control misalignment, leading to inconsistent maneuvers and unreliable termination. To address this issue, we propose DBFly, a vision-language waypoint prediction framework that introduces explicit vision-guided spatial deliberation before waypoint generation. Specifically, DBFly introduces a spatial maneuver decision chain that progressively performs target-direction anchoring, spatial diagnosis, and maneuver decision, enabling high-level maneuver intent to explicitly guide continuous waypoint generation. DBFly further constructs an implicit flight corridor by transforming the initial target-direction prior into a persistent geometric reference and deriving an online corridor state from the UAV's current position, thereby providing soft geometric guidance for spatial diagnosis and maneuver correction. In addition, DBFly develops a terminal-convergence-aware stopping strategy that characterizes terminal states through both target proximity and short-horizon motion convergence, enabling more reliable stopping near the target. Extensive experiments across seen, unseen-object, and unseen-scene test sets demonstrate that DBFly improves the success rate over the SOTA baseline by an average of 25.07 percentage points. The project homepage is available at https://xuefanfu.github.io/DBFly-Page.
tldr: DBFly introduces explicit vision-guided spatial deliberation via a maneuver decision chain and implicit flight corridor for UAV see-and-reach navigation, achieving significant gains over baselines.
tldr_zh: DBFly 通过引入显式的视觉引导空间推理（机动决策链和隐式飞行走廊）来改善无人机视觉-语言导航任务，在多个测试集上显著提升了成功率。
summary_zh: 无人机“看见并抵达”导航需要飞行器接近初始视图中可见的语言指定目标，并在其附近可靠地停止。现有方法通常将视觉-语言表征直接映射为动作输出，而未显式建模中间细粒度的空间决策。这种直接映射导致语义与控制失调，引发不一致的机动行为与不可靠的终止。为解决此问题，我们提出DBFly——一种视觉-语言航点预测框架，在航点生成前引入显式的视觉引导空间推演。具体而言，DBFly引入空间机动决策链，逐步执行目标方向锚定、空间诊断与机动决策，使高层机动意图显式引导连续航点生成。DBFly进一步通过将初始目标方向先验转化为持久几何参考，并基于无人机当前位置推导在线走廊状态，构建隐式飞行走廊，从而为空间诊断与机动修正提供软几何引导。此外，DBFly开发了一种终端收敛感知的停止策略，通过目标接近度与短时域运动收敛性共同表征终端状态，实现更可靠的目标附近停止。在已知、未见目标及未见场景测试集上的大量实验表明，DBFly相比SOTA基线方法平均提升25.07个百分点的成功率。项目主页：https://xuefanfu.github.io/DBFly-Page。

title: Explicit Language Memory for Long-Horizon Planning in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a unified paradigm for connecting visual perception, language understanding, and robotic control. However, existing VLA models still face major challenges in long-horizon tasks: sparse expert demonstrations constrain cross-task compositional generalization; the non-Markovian nature of long-horizon tasks makes it difficult for policies conditioned only on current observations to maintain temporal consistency; limited closed-loop error correction allows execution errors to accumulate; and end-to-end action fine-tuning may weaken the high-level semantic representations of vision-language model (VLM) backbones. To address these issues, we propose a hierarchical long-horizon VLA architecture with an explicit language-memory module. The central idea is to convert discrete temporal observations into a coherent textual memory sequence with temporal logic. The system is decoupled into a high-level VLM and a low-level VLA: the high-level VLM performs semantic reasoning through a visual question answering training paradigm, while the low-level VLA executes precise continuous control conditioned on subtask instructions and visual observations. The high-level VLM recursively updates both language memory and subtask instructions using the previous memory as a contextual anchor, enabling persistent temporal tracking and dynamic correction during long-horizon execution. We evaluate the proposed method in multiple simulation environments and conduct sim-to-real experiments on a real robotic platform. The results demonstrate that explicit language memory improves the success rate and robustness of VLA models on complex long-horizon tasks while providing an interpretable semantic account of the decision process.
tldr: Proposes a hierarchical VLA architecture with an explicit language memory module that converts temporal observations into textual memory sequences, enabling persistent tracking and dynamic correction for long-horizon manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种带有显式语言记忆模块的分层VLA架构，将时序观测转化为文本记忆序列，实现长时间任务中的持续跟踪与动态纠错。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为连接视觉感知、语言理解与机器人控制提供了统一范式。然而，现有VLA模型在长时域任务中仍面临重大挑战：稀疏的专家演示限制了跨任务组合泛化能力；长时域任务的非马尔可夫性使得仅依赖于当前观测的策略难以维持时间一致性；有限的闭环纠错能力导致执行误差持续累积；端到端动作微调可能削弱视觉-语言模型（VLM）主干的高层语义表征能力。针对上述问题，本文提出一种带有显式语言记忆模块的分层长时域VLA架构。其核心思想是将离散的时间观测转化为具有时序逻辑的连贯文本记忆序列。系统被解耦为高层VLM与低层VLA：高层VLM通过视觉问答训练范式执行语义推理，低层VLA则基于子任务指令与视觉观测执行精准连续控制。高层VLM以先前记忆作为上下文锚点，递归更新语言记忆与子任务指令，从而在长时域执行过程中实现持续时序追踪与动态纠偏。我们在多个仿真环境中评估所提方法，并在真实机器人平台上开展仿真到真实迁移实验。结果表明，显式语言记忆在提升VLA模型复杂长时域任务成功率与鲁棒性的同时，还为决策过程提供了可解释的语义描述。

title: VLAff: Vision-Language-Affordance Model for Unified Actionable Affordances
summary: Learning manipulation skills from human videos is promising for scalable robot learning. However, the embodiment mismatch between humans and robots makes this challenging. One promising solution is to learn object-centric actionable affordances that are embodiment-agnostic. In this work, we propose a framework that leverages egocentric human videos with state-of-the-art 3D Structure-from-Motion and hand mesh reconstruction to extract actionable affordances such as visual, grasp, and trajectory affordances that explicitly encode where to interact, how to grasp, and how to move. We construct EgoAffordance, a large-scale dataset comprising 204K episodes with 5.6M visual affordances and 11.6M grasp and trajectory affordances. Building on this, we introduce VLAff, a large vision-language model-based unified foundation model that learns cross-modal correlations across all actionable affordances. Given a visual observation and instruction, VLAff generates visual affordance heatmaps, grasp poses, and trajectories, which are then converted into directly executable actions by utilizing 3D scene information. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that VLAff not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual affordance prediction, but can also be effectively applied to real robot applications such as zero-shot manipulation and affordance-guided robot learning.
tldr: VLAff is a vision-language-action foundation model that learns object-centric actionable affordances (visual, grasp, trajectory) from egocentric human videos and converts them into robot-executable actions for zero-shot manipulation.
tldr_zh: VLAff 是一个视觉-语言-动作基础模型，从人类自我中心视频中学习物体中心的可操作affordances（视觉、抓取、轨迹），并将其转化为机器人可执行的零样本操作动作。
summary_zh: 从人类视频中学习操作技能为可扩展的机器人学习带来了广阔前景。然而，人类与机器人之间的具身差异使得这一任务极具挑战性。一种有前景的解决方法是学习与物体相关的、不依赖具身的可操作可供性。本文提出一种框架，通过利用自我中心视角的人类视频，结合先进的运动恢复结构和手部网格重建技术，提取视觉可供性、抓取可供性和轨迹可供性等可操作表征，明确编码交互位置、抓取方式及运动路径。我们构建了EgoAffordance大规模数据集，包含20.4万个片段、560万个视觉可供性实例及1160万个抓取与轨迹可供性实例。在此基础上，提出VLAff——基于大型视觉语言模型的统一基础框架，学习所有可操作可供性之间的跨模态关联。给定视觉观测与指令，VLAff生成视觉可供性热力图、抓取位姿及运动轨迹，并通过利用三维场景信息将其转化为可直接执行的机器人动作。大量实验表明，VLAff不仅在视觉可供性预测上达到最优性能，还能有效应用于零样本操作及可供性引导的机器人学习等真实机器人场景。

title: Mind-VLA: Instruction-Aware Spatial Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) methods improve generalization by aligning their representations with 3D scene geometry. However, these methods are fundamentally instruction-agnostic: the representations align the entire scene uniformly, neglecting the 3D geometry of the specific target object designated by the language instruction. This causes failures on fine-grained manipulation and target occlusion tasks, where success depends on accurate 3D understanding of the target object rather than the entire scene. To address this, we present Mind-VLA, an instruction-aware spatial representation alignment method for VLA models. Specifically, Mind-VLA first obtains the target object specified by the language instruction, then prepares its target-object tri-view and extracts the corresponding VAE and VGGT features. Finally, the latent representation of the VLA model is aligned with these features to enable instruction-aware 3D understanding. Mind-VLA reaches 93.9% on LIBERO and 4.47 on CALVIN with a compact 345M-parameter backbone. On real-robot tasks with target occlusion, Mind-VLA reaches 54% average success, outperforming the best-performing instruction-agnostic method in real-robot comparison by 32 percentage points. Code will be publicly available.
tldr: Mind-VLA introduces instruction-aware spatial representation alignment for Vision-Language-Action models, focusing on the target object's 3D geometry rather than the entire scene, achieving significant improvements in fine-grained manipulation and occlusion tasks.
tldr_zh: Mind-VLA 针对视觉-语言-动作模型提出指令感知的空间表征对齐方法，聚焦语言指令指定目标物体的三维几何而非整个场景，在精细操作和遮挡任务上取得显著提升。
summary_zh: 最近，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）方法通过将其表征与三维场景几何结构对齐来提升泛化能力。然而，这类方法本质上是指令无关的：其表征均匀地对齐整个场景，忽略了语言指令所指定的特定目标物体的三维几何结构。这导致在细粒度操作和目标遮挡任务中失败，因为此类任务的成功取决于对目标物体而非整个场景的精确三维理解。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Mind-VLA——一种面向VLA模型的指令感知空间表征对齐方法。具体而言，Mind-VLA首先获取语言指令指定的目标物体，随后生成其目标物体三视图并提取对应的VAE和VGGT特征。最后，将VLA模型的潜表征与这些特征进行对齐，从而实现指令感知的三维理解。Mind-VLA在LIBERO数据集上达到93.9%的准确率，在CALVIN数据集上达到4.47的得分，其骨干网络仅含345M参数。在存在目标遮挡的真实机器人任务中，Mind-VLA实现了54%的平均成功率，在真实机器人对比实验中，比表现最优的指令无关方法高出32个百分点。相关代码将公开提供。

title: Retrieve in Time, Correct in Frequency
summary: Frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate temporally extended action chunks, but long-horizon manipulation remains vulnerable to accumulated execution error and visual aliasing across task stages. Successful rollouts provide useful corrective evidence, yet current frame retrieval can return progress-misaligned actions,while direct replay or time-domain fusion can overwrite the reactive structure of the policy proposal. We introduce Retrieve in Time, Correct in Frequency (RTCF), a training-free test-time correction framework that improves frozen VLA performance with low model-side overhead.RTCF separates which experience to retrieve from which part of its action to transfer. Progressive Memory Alignment (PMA) causally aligns the growing visual execution history with complete successful trajectories through incrementally updated monotonic frontiers, jointly identifying a relevant memory and the current aligned memory position without stage labels. From the aligned action chunk,RTCF transfers a coefficient-wise-clipped low-frequency residual on motion channels. Higher-frequency components and gripper decisions remain inherited from the frozen policy. Across four LIBERO suites and 2,000 episodes per condition, RTCF raises aggregate success from 86.4% to 88.4% and improves LIBERO-Long from 61.6% to 68.6%.These gains require no parameter updates, repeated VLA inference, or additional GPU resources: correction can be performed on the client CPU after a single policy invocation, and the median latencies sum to only 10.99 ms per action chunk
tldr: RTCF is a training-free, test-time correction framework that improves frozen VLA policies for long-horizon manipulation by retrieving aligned experience and transferring low-frequency action residuals.
tldr_zh: RTCF 是一种无需训练的测试时修正框架，通过检索对齐经验并传递低频动作残差来改进冻结的 VLA 策略在长程操作中的表现。
summary_zh: 冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能够生成时间上延展的动作片段，但在长时程操作中仍易受累积执行误差及跨任务阶段的视觉混淆影响。成功的执行轨迹能提供有效的修正依据，然而当前的帧检索可能返回与任务进度不一致的动作，而直接回放或时域融合则会覆盖策略建议的响应式结构。我们提出"时域检索，频域修正"（RTCF）框架，这是一种无需训练、仅需测试时修正的方案，能以较低的模型端开销提升冻结VLA性能。RTCF将"检索哪段经验"与"迁移其动作的哪部分"进行分离。渐进记忆对齐（PMA）通过递增更新的单调边界，将不断增长的视觉执行历史与完整成功轨迹进行因果对齐，在不依赖阶段标签的情况下联合识别相关记忆及当前对齐的记忆位置。从对齐的动作片段中，RTCF在运动通道上迁移经系数裁剪的低频残差，而高频分量和夹爪决策则继承自冻结策略。在四个LIBERO任务套件中，每种条件进行2000次试验，RTCF将总成功任务率从86.4%提升至88.4%，其中LIBERO-Long任务从61.6%提升至68.6%。这些增益无需参数更新、重复VLA推理或额外GPU资源：单次策略调用后，修正可在客户端CPU上执行，每个动作片段的中位延迟总和仅为10.99毫秒。

title: GUARD: Grounding Uncertainty and Ablation-Based Risk Detection for Diffusion-Based VLAs
summary: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies can generate plausible actions even when their predictions are weakly grounded in the visual and language evidence defining the task. We introduce GUARD, a test-time failure detection method that measures this grounding without modifying the pretrained policy. GUARD estimates the influence of token-indexed entries in the final vision-language model key-value (KV) cache, constructs counterfactual caches by ablating salient KV entries, and compares their denoising responses with the original conditioning. Based on the comparison, we derive GUARD diagnostic stream including sensitivity, attention entropy, modality bias, and grounding efficiency, which are calibrated online and processed by a lightweight temporal classifier. We evaluate GUARD under task-held-out splits across five policy-benchmark settings, using Pi0, SmolVLA, and Alpamayo-1.5 on LIBERO, SimplerEnv, MetaWorld, and PhysicalAI-AV. GUARD achieves the best ROC-AUC on four of five unseen-task settings and ranks second on the remaining setting, improving the average unseen-task ROC-AUC by 5.73 percentage points over the strongest competing runtime monitor while remaining within 0.19 points of the best seen-task average. These results show that directly probing action-head dependence on multimodal evidence provides a transferable failure signal across policies, tasks, embodiments, and domains.
tldr: GUARD is a test-time failure detection method for diffusion-based VLA policies that measures grounding by ablating salient KV-cache entries and comparing denoising responses, improving ROC-AUC on unseen task splits across multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: GUARD 是一种用于扩散视觉-语言-动作策略的测试时故障检测方法，通过消融关键的 KV 缓存条目并比较去噪响应来测量接地性，在多项基准测试的未见任务划分上提升了 ROC-AUC。
summary_zh: 基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略即便在动作预测与定义任务的视觉和语言证据之间关联较弱时，仍能生成看似合理的动作。我们提出GUARD方法，这是一种测试时故障检测方法，可在不修改预训练策略的前提下衡量这种关联性。GUARD通过估计最终视觉-语言模型键值（KV）缓存中由token索引条目的影响，剔除显著KV条目构建反事实缓存，并将去噪响应与原始条件进行对比。基于对比结果，我们推导出GUARD诊断流，包括敏感性、注意力熵、模态偏差和关联效率，这些指标经过在线校准并由轻量级时序分类器处理。我们在五个策略基准设置的任务留出划分下进行评估，使用Pi0、SmolVLA和Alpamayo-1.5模型在LIBERO、SimplerEnv、MetaWorld和PhysicalAI-AV数据集上测试。GUARD在五个未见任务设置中的四个取得最佳ROC-AUC值，并在剩余设置中排名第二，将未见任务平均ROC-AUC较最强竞品运行时监测器提升5.73个百分点，同时与已见任务最佳平均值的差距保持在0.19个百分点以内。这些结果表明，直接探测动作头部对多模态证据的依赖性，可提供跨越策略、任务、具身形态和领域的可迁移故障信号。

title: SAFECAST: Robust Failure Detection for VLA Policies with Contrast-Set Training and Calibration
summary: Vision-language-action policies often fail under deployment-time distribution shifts such as clutter, distractor objects, lighting changes, novel objects, altered initial states, and reworded instructions. Hidden-state-based risk probes combined with functional conformal prediction can detect rollout failures, but their reliability depends on calibration data matching deployment conditions. We introduce SAFECAST, which leverages contrast set perturbations to improve hidden-state probe training and calibration for deployment time shift. SAFECAST statistically significantly improves failure detection ROC-AUC scores over a state of the art baseline in both real-world DROID and LIBERO simulation experiments across multiple VLM backbones. We further find that SAFECAST benefits most when both visual and language contrast set perturbations are used to augment data, and that with contrast set perturbations, sim-to-real calibration leads to better probes than using real rollout data only.
tldr: SAFECAST improves failure detection in VLA policies under distribution shifts by using contrast-set perturbations to enhance hidden-state probe training and calibration, outperforming baselines on real-world and simulated robot data.
tldr_zh: SAFECAST通过使用对比集扰动增强隐藏状态探针训练和校准，改进了VLA策略在分布偏移下的故障检测，在真实和模拟机器人数据上优于基线。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作策略在部署时的分布偏移（如场景杂乱、干扰物体、光照变化、未见物体、初始状态改变及指令重述）下常常失效。基于隐状态的风险探针结合函数共形预测可检测部署过程中的失败，但其可靠性依赖于校准数据与部署条件的一致性。我们提出SAFECAST方法，利用对比集扰动改进隐状态探针的训练与校准，以应对部署时的分布偏移。在多个VLM骨干网络下的真实DROID与LIBERO仿真实验中，SAFECAST在失败检测的ROC-AUC指标上相较现有最优基线取得了统计显著的提升。进一步发现，同时使用视觉与语言对比集扰动扩增数据时SAFECAST受益最大，且引入对比集扰动后，基于仿真到真实校准所得探针优于仅使用真实部署数据校准的结果。

title: SiMDex: Mining Similar Egocentric Videos for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Recent years have witnessed an explosive trend of scaling ego-centric human videos for robot manipulation, yet it remains unclear which data actually benefits dexterous manipulation. We present SiMDex, a similarity-based data mining framework that casts human data selection for VLA post-training in dexterous manipulation as a recommendation problem. For each robot demonstration, SiMDex employs a three-layer recall-ranking-re-ranking pipeline to extract task-relevant subsets from a pool of ~32M egocentric human samples, operating in a morphology-agnostic action space that requires no changes to VLA architecture or training. Against a strong baseline trained with an equal amount of randomly sampled human data, SiMDex uses only ~1.49M mined samples (<5% of the pool) yet improves the overall success rate from 47.7% to 61.1%, showing that selective curation outperforms indiscriminate data mixing.
tldr: SiMDex proposes a similarity-based data mining framework that selects task-relevant egocentric human video subsets for dexterous manipulation VLA post-training, improving success rate from 47.7% to 61.1% using less than 5% of a 32M-sample pool.
tldr_zh: SiMDex 提出了一种基于相似度的数据挖掘框架，从约3200万条第一人称人类视频中筛选出任务相关子集，用于灵巧操作的VLA后训练，仅使用不到5%的数据便将成功率从47.7%提升至61.1%。
summary_zh: 近年来，以自我为中心视角的人类操作视频在机器人操控领域呈现爆发式规模化增长，但究竟何种数据能真正有益于灵巧操控仍不明确。本文提出SiMDex——一种基于相似性的数据挖掘框架，将灵巧操控中面向VLA后训练的人类数据选择问题重构为推荐问题。针对每条机器人示教数据，SiMDex采用“召回-排序-重排序”三层流水线，从约3200万段自我中心视角人类样本池中提取任务相关子集，并在无需改变VLA架构或训练流程的形态无关动作空间中运行。与使用同等数量随机采样人类数据训练的强基线相比，SiMDex仅需约149万挖掘样本（不足样本池总量的5%），即可将整体成功率从47.7%提升至61.1%，证明选择性数据筛选优于无差别数据混合。

title: WorldCycle: Self-Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Video World Models
summary: Interactive video world models are essential for long-horizon planning and exploration, yet they suffer from compounding errors. Post-training methods such as reinforcement learning (RL) can improve these models, but they hit a verification bottleneck: for arbitrary action sequences, no ground-truth future state exists to measure long-term drift. Our key insight is that reversible action cycles make this verification possible: a sequence composed with its inverse must analytically return to the initial state, yielding annotation-free supervision on long-horizon correctness. Building on this, we introduce WorldCycle, a self-verifiable RL framework that constructs closed action cycles and their repeated executions from ordinary action sequences, and optimizes two complementary rewards: a spatial closure reward enforcing symmetry between mirrored forward and reverse segments, and a temporal consistency reward aligning states across repeated cycle executions. These rewards force the model to learn actions as consistent state operators rather than memorized temporal patterns, and extend naturally to out-of-distribution composite action cycles that the base model handles poorly. We further release CycleBench, a diagnostic benchmark for state-returning ability under complex action structures. WorldCycle reduces state returning drift by up to 44% and lifts composite-action accuracy nearly 4x over the base model, providing a vital foundation for physically grounded world models.
tldr: This paper introduces WorldCycle, a self-verifiable RL framework that uses reversible action cycles to generate annotation-free supervision for long-horizon video world models, significantly reducing drift and improving composite-action accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了WorldCycle，一个自验证的强化学习框架，利用可逆动作循环为长时域视频世界模型生成无标注监督信号，显著降低漂移并提高复合动作准确性。
summary_zh: 交互式视频世界模型对于长时域规划与探索至关重要，但其存在误差累积问题。强化学习等后训练方法虽能改善此类模型，却面临验证瓶颈：对于任意动作序列，不存在真实未来状态用以衡量长期漂移。我们的关键洞察在于，可逆动作循环使该验证成为可能——由逆动作构成的序列在理论上必须返回初始状态，从而为长时域正确性提供无需标注的监督信号。基于此，我们提出WorldCycle——一种自验证强化学习框架，通过将普通动作序列构建为封闭动作循环及其重复执行，并优化两种互补奖励：空间闭合性奖励强制镜像正向与反向段落的对称性，时间一致性奖励对齐重复循环执行中的状态。这些奖励迫使模型将动作学习为一致的状态算子，而非记忆化的时间模式，并能自然扩展至基础模型难以处理的分布外复合动作循环。我们进一步发布CycleBench——面向复杂动作结构下状态返回能力的诊断基准。WorldCycle将状态返回漂移降低44%，复合动作准确率提升近4倍，为具身物理世界模型奠定重要基础。

title: NSF-HRPT: Neural Semantic Field meets Hierarchical Risk Perception Tree for Safety-Critical Scenario Assessment
summary: The ability to accurately assess and anticipate risks in safety-critical scenarios is crucial for autonomous driving systems. While existing research has made progress in collision prediction, accurately quantifying risk levels from monocular vision inputs remains challenging due to the complex dynamics of multi-agent interactions and the inherent uncertainty in real-world environments. To address these challenges, we present NSF-HRPT, a novel framework that combines learning-based perception with structured reasoning for quantitative risk assessment. Our approach features a Neural Semantic Field (NSF) that learns to model scene semantics, trajectory predictions, and probabilistic Time-to-Collision (TTC) distributions from simulation data. During inference, the pre-trained NSF serves as a prior for our Hierarchical Risk Perception Tree (HRPT), which enables efficient parallel computation and spatial reasoning about multi-agent risks. Additionally, we introduce a Sim2Real enhancement strategy that improves real-world applicability without retraining by incorporating priors from foundation models. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on synthetic benchmarks and delivers competitive, near-state-of-the-art results on real-world datasets for both TTC estimation accuracy and risk localization precision. The proposed method provides an effective solution for real-time risk awareness from monocular camera inputs.
tldr: NSF-HRPT combines a Neural Semantic Field with a Hierarchical Risk Perception Tree to enable real-time quantitative risk assessment for autonomous driving from monocular video, achieving strong results on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.
tldr_zh: NSF-HRPT 将神经语义场与分层风险感知树相结合，从单目视频中实现自动驾驶的实时定量风险评估，在合成和真实世界基准上均取得了优异效果。
summary_zh: 准确评估和预测安全关键场景中的风险能力对于自动驾驶系统至关重要。尽管现有研究在碰撞预测方面取得了进展，但由于多智能体交互的复杂动态特性以及真实环境中固有的不确定性，从单目视觉输入中精确量化风险水平仍然具有挑战性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了NSF-HRPT，一种将基于学习的感知与结构化推理相结合的新型框架，用于定量风险评估。该方法包含一个神经语义场（NSF），可从仿真数据中学习建模场景语义、轨迹预测以及概率性碰撞时间（TTC）分布。在推理阶段，预训练的NSF作为层次化风险感知树（HRPT）的先验知识，实现对多智能体风险的高效并行计算与空间推理。此外，我们引入了一种Sim2Real增强策略，通过融合基础模型的先验知识，在不重新训练的情况下提升了现实世界的适用性。大量评估表明，该框架在合成基准测试中达到了最先进性能，并在真实世界数据集上就TTC估计精度与风险定位精准度而言，取得了具有竞争力的、接近最先进水平的结果。所提方法为基于单目摄像头输入的实时风险感知提供了一种有效解决方案。

title: TwinIR: Coordinated Invisible Dual-Point Attacks on Online HD Map Construction
summary: Online HD map construction is critical to prediction and planning in autonomous driving. We find that existing physical attacks against online map construction are limited by a cross-boundary compensation effect: after the target boundary is perturbed, another visible boundary may retain sufficient geometric cues for the model to recover the original road geometry. Based on this observation, we propose TwinIR, a new mechanism-guided physical attack methodology for online map construction. TwinIR jointly optimizes attack effectiveness and point sparsity, seeking the minimum number of attack points needed to suppress compensating geometric cues from surrounding boundaries. To reduce the perceptibility of multi-point attacks, TwinIR models camera responses to near-infrared illumination and maps optimized attack points to feasible physical placements, producing camera-visible interference with minimal visible-spectrum changes. Experiments on nuScenes across state-of-the-art online map construction models show that TwinIR reduces mAP by 8.18-8.96 percentage points under RSA and 2.84-5.62 points under ETA, while increasing the unreachable-goal rate by 25-28 points and the unsafe-planned-trajectory rate by 19-20 points over clean inputs. These attacks are also validated on a real-world testbed AV, where TwinIR successfully induces both road straightening and early-turn deformations while remaining inconspicuous in full-color views.
tldr: TwinIR proposes a mechanism-guided physical attack methodology for online HD map construction in autonomous driving, using coordinated dual-point near-infrared attacks to suppress geometric compensation cues and degrade planning safety.
tldr_zh: TwinIR 提出了一种针对自动驾驶在线高精地图构建的机制引导物理攻击方法，通过协调的双点近红外攻击抑制几何补偿线索，从而降低规划安全性。
summary_zh: 在线高清地图构建对自动驾驶中的预测与规划至关重要。我们发现现有针对在线地图构建的物理攻击受限于一种跨边界补偿效应：当目标边界被扰动后，另一可见边界可能保留足够几何线索，使模型能够恢复原始道路几何结构。基于这一观察，我们提出TwinIR——一种面向在线地图构建的新型机制引导物理攻击方法。TwinIR联合优化攻击效能与点稀疏性，寻求抑制周边边界补偿几何线索所需的最少攻击点数量。为降低多点攻击的可感知性，TwinIR对近红外照明下的相机响应进行建模，并将优化后的攻击点映射为可行的物理布设，从而在可见光谱变化最小化的前提下产生相机可见干扰。在nuScenes数据集上针对当前最先进的在线地图构建模型进行的实验表明：与干净输入相比，TwinIR在RSA指标下将mAP降低8.18-8.96个百分点，在ETA指标下降低2.84-5.62个百分点，同时使不可达目标率提高25-28个百分点、不安全规划轨迹率提高19-20个百分点。这些攻击还在真实世界测试平台AV上得到验证，TwinIR成功诱发了道路拉直与提前转弯两种形变，且在彩色全景视图中保持隐蔽性。

title: muSync-GS: Physics-Synchronized Driving Video Synthesis for Weather and Geometric Road Hazards
summary: High-quality driving data are essential for autonomous-driving systems and generative world models. However, rare and safety-critical scenarios involving adverse weather, braking under low tire--road friction, and uneven road geometry are costly and risky to collect at scale. Existing video-generation and 3D Gaussian editing methods can modify weather appearance or road geometry, but typically do not couple these edits with tire--road interaction and vehicle dynamics. As a result, an edited video may retain its original trajectory even when the modified road condition should alter braking, wheel slip, load transfer, and ego-camera motion. We present muSync-GS, a physics-synchronized framework for driving video synthesis under adverse-weather and road-elevation hazards. A precipitation-derived road-surface condition jointly controls road appearance and tire friction, while a shared road-elevation profile drives both visible road-geometry editing and axle excitation. A calibrated vehicle model predicts speed, slip ratio, normal loads, and pitch for constructing the ego-camera trajectory and synchronized physical annotations. On 12 held-out CarSim cases spanning precipitation levels, brake inputs, and road-profile parameters, the model achieves mean case-wise RMSEs of 0.0273 m/s for speed, 0.0590 degrees for pitch, 0.0101 for slip ratio, and 26.61 N for per-wheel normal load. Together with the reconstructed-scene experiments, these results show that muSync-GS accurately reproduces vehicle responses under held-out controls while synchronizing them with controllable scene edits and ego-camera motion.
tldr: muSync-GS is a physics-synchronized framework for driving video synthesis that couples weather and road-geometry edits with vehicle dynamics, producing physically plausible ego-camera motion and annotations.
tldr_zh: muSync-GS是一个物理同步的驾驶视频合成框架，将天气和道路几何编辑与车辆动力学耦合，生成物理合理的自车相机运动与标注。
summary_zh: 高质量驾驶数据对于自动驾驶系统和生成式世界模型至关重要。然而，涉及恶劣天气、低轮胎-路面摩擦下的制动以及不平整道路几何形状等罕见且安全关键的场景，在规模化采集中成本高昂且风险巨大。现有的视频生成和3D高斯编辑方法能够修改天气外观或道路几何形状，但通常无法将这些编辑与轮胎-路面相互作用及车辆动力学耦合。因此，即便修改后的道路状况本应改变制动、车轮滑移、载荷转移及自车相机运动，编辑后的视频仍可能保留原始轨迹。我们提出muSync-GS，一种在恶劣天气和道路高程危险条件下实现物理同步的驾驶视频合成框架。基于降水的道路表面条件联合控制道路外观与轮胎摩擦，而共享的道路高程剖面则同时驱动可见道路几何编辑与车轴激励。经标定的车辆模型可预测速度、滑移率、法向载荷及俯仰角，用于构建自车相机轨迹与同步的物理标注。在涵盖降水量级、制动输入及道路剖面参数的12个保留CarSim测试案例中，该模型在速度、俯仰角、滑移率及每轮法向载荷上分别达到0.0273 m/s、0.0590度、0.0101及26.61 N的逐案例均方根误差。结合重建场景实验，这些结果表明muSync-GS能够在受控保留条件下精确复现车辆响应，同时将其与可控场景编辑及自车相机运动实现同步。

title: Faster-WAM: Efficient Inference-Time Future Conditioning for Robust World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot manipulation by learning how the environment evolves beyond the current observation. However, existing approaches face a fundamental dilemma: Joint-WAMs preserve future-aware representations during inference but incur prohibitive computation costs, while efficient alternatives remove future modeling at inference time and may lose the robustness benefits of temporal reasoning. In this work, we revisit the role of future representations in WAMs and show that inference-time future conditioning is critical for generalization under distribution shifts. This observation motivates Faster-WAM, an efficient future-conditioning WAM that preserves future representations while avoiding expensive video-action interaction. Faster-WAM introduces a sparse future-conditioning framework that computes future representations once and selectively reuses them throughout action denoising. Specifically, we propose SparseMoT to replace ubiquitous layer-wise fusion with selective video-action interaction at a compact subset of network stages, and Interval KV-Fusion to aggregate multi-depth future representations without increasing attention complexity. Experiments demonstrate that Faster-WAM achieves a substantially better performance-efficiency trade-off than existing WAMs. On the out-of-distribution LIBERO-Plus benchmark, Faster-WAM improves success rate from 49.14% to 73.57% compared with Fast-WAM, while running 2.21$\times$ faster than Joint-WAM. It further achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0, while demonstrating strong robustness in real-world manipulation.
tldr: Faster-WAM introduces a sparse future-conditioning framework for World Action Models, achieving better performance-efficiency trade-offs in robot manipulation by selectively reusing future representations during action denoising.
tldr_zh: Faster-WAM 提出了一种稀疏未来条件框架，用于世界动作模型，通过选择性重用动作去噪过程中的未来表示，在机器人操作中实现了更好的性能-效率权衡。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过学习环境在当前观测之外的演化规律，提升了机器人操作能力。然而现有方法面临根本性困境：联合式WAM（Joint-WAM）在推理过程中保留未来感知表征，但计算成本高昂；而高效替代方案在推理时移除未来建模，可能丧失时序推理的鲁棒性优势。本研究重新审视未来表征在WAM中的作用，揭示推理阶段的未来条件约束对于分布偏移下的泛化能力至关重要。这一发现促使我们提出Faster-WAM——一种高效的条件约束未来WAM，其在避免高开销视频-动作交互的前提下保留未来表征。Faster-WAM引入稀疏未来条件约束框架，通过一次性计算未来表征并在动作去噪过程中选择性复用。具体而言，我们提出SparseMoT模块，在紧凑的网络阶段子集上以选择性视频-动作交互替代逐层融合机制，并设计Interval KV-Fusion方法，在不增加注意力计算复杂度的情况下聚合多层级未来表征。实验表明，Faster-WAM相比现有WAM实现了显著更优的性能-效率平衡。在分布外LIBERO-Plus基准测试中，Faster-WAM相较Fast-WAM将成功率从49.14%提升至73.57%，同时运行速度比Joint-WAM快2.21倍。该模型在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0数据集上进一步达到最优性能，并在真实场景操作中展现出强鲁棒性。

title: CofactVLA: Deconfounding Vision-Language-Action Models via Counterfactual Intervention
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have driven significant progress in robotic manipulation, yet they fundamentally struggle with the vision-override phenomenon. Driven by the severe modality imbalance between dense visual streams and sparse linguistic instructions, VLAs frequently fall prey to causal confusion. Instead of treating language as the primary causal driver, the policy entirely bypasses the original instruction by overfitting to spurious visual confounders, such as prominent objects or familiar layouts. To systematically alleviate this bias, we formalize the process of action generation as a Dual-path Deconfounding Graph (DDG) and propose CofactVLA, a novel causal intervention framework. By dynamically constructing a language-masked counterfactual branch within a single forward pass, CofactVLA isolates and neutralizes visual confounders through two synergistic mechanisms. First, Action-Level Orthogonal Projection Guidance (OPG) geometrically projects the factual velocity field away from the counterfactual visual bias during continuous flow matching, extracting the pure semantic intent. Second, Feature-Level Counterfactual Covariance Reduction (CCR) mathematically deconfounds latent representations by penalizing the positive eigenspace of the covariance difference, explicitly suppressing dominant visual shortcuts while preserving the causal language intent. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CofactVLA establishes a new state-of-the-art across diverse simulation benchmarks. Beyond simulation, real-world robot experiments demonstrate the causal efficacy of our method in bridging the generalization gap, yielding a 52.3\% absolute success rate gain under out-of-distribution scenarios.
tldr: CofactVLA proposes a causal intervention framework with dual-path deconfounding to mitigate the vision-override bias in VLA models, achieving SOTA on simulation benchmarks and significant real-world gains.
tldr_zh: CofactVLA 提出了一种因果干预框架，通过双路径去混淆来缓解 VLA 模型中的视觉覆盖偏差，在仿真基准上达到 SOTA，并在真实场景中取得显著提升。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作领域取得了显著进展，但其本质上受困于"视觉主导"现象。由于密集视觉流与稀疏语言指令之间存在严重的模态不平衡，VLA模型常陷入因果混淆。策略并未将语言作为主要因果驱动因素，而是通过过度拟合虚假视觉混杂因素（如显著物体或熟悉布局）完全绕过原始指令。为系统缓解这一偏差，我们将动作生成过程形式化为双路径解构因果图（DDG），并提出新型因果干预框架CofactVLA。该框架通过在前向传播过程中动态构建语言掩蔽的反事实分支，通过两种协同机制隔离并中和视觉混杂因素：其一，动作级正交投影引导（OPG）在连续流匹配过程中将事实速度场几何投影至远离反事实视觉偏差的方向，从而提取纯语义意图；其二，特征级反事实协方差缩减（CCR）通过惩罚协方差差值的正特征空间，在数学上解构潜在表征的混杂因素，在保留因果语言意图的同时显式抑制主导性视觉捷径。大量实验表明，CofactVLA在多种仿真基准测试中均达到最新最优水平。除仿真环境外，真实机器人实验验证了该方法在弥合泛化差距方面的因果有效性，在分布外场景下实现了52.3%的绝对成功率提升。

title: Learning When to Stop: Prefix-Optimal Dynamic Diffusion Policies for Continuous Control
summary: Diffusion policies are a powerful policy class for continuous control, but their iterative denoising process creates a substantial computational bottleneck. Reducing this cost requires adapting the number of denoising steps to the difficulty of each action while preserving task performance. We introduce Prefix-Optimal Generative Policies (POGP), a framework that learns a prefix value function at every intermediate denoising step through a Bellman-style recursion over the denoising chain. The prefix value function serves two purposes: it provides an auxiliary training objective that encourages intermediate outputs to become high-quality actions, and it enables a test-time stopping rule that terminates denoising when additional steps are unlikely to produce meaningful improvement. Across four MuJoCo environments and comparisons with 12 baselines, POGP reduces the required number of denoising iterations by approximately 2.7-fold while retaining near-full task performance. Compared with state-of-the-art dynamic diffusion baselines, prefix training also improves final task performance by approximately 3.5%. These results indicate that supervising intermediate denoising steps is useful not only for adaptive early stopping, but also as an auxiliary objective that improves the learned policy.
tldr: This paper proposes POGP, a framework that learns a prefix value function over the denoising chain of diffusion policies to enable adaptive early stopping, reducing computational cost by ~2.7x while improving task performance by ~3.5% in continuous control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出POGP框架，通过在扩散策略的去噪链上学习前缀价值函数实现自适应早停，在连续控制任务中减少约2.7倍计算开销的同时提升约3.5%的任务性能。
summary_zh: 扩散策略是一类强大的连续控制策略，但其迭代去噪过程造成了严重的计算瓶颈。降低这一成本需要根据每个动作的难度调整去噪步数，同时保持任务性能。我们提出前缀最优生成策略（POGP），该框架通过去噪链上的贝尔曼式递归学习每个中间去噪步骤的前缀值函数。前缀值函数具有双重作用：一方面提供辅助训练目标，促使中间输出成为高质量动作；另一方面实现测试时停止规则——当后续步骤难以产生有意义改进时终止去噪。在四个MuJoCo环境及与12个基准方法的比较中，POGP将所需去噪迭代次数减少约2.7倍，同时保持接近完整的任务性能。与最先进的动态扩散基准方法相比，前缀训练还将最终任务性能提升约3.5%。这些结果表明，监督中间去噪步骤不仅有助于自适应早停，还能作为提升所学策略质量的辅助目标。

title: Mimir: A Neuro-Symbolic Memory System with Dynamic Grounding for Embodied Agents in Interactive Environments
summary: Long-horizon embodied task requires agents to act under partial observability while preserving both scene belief and execution progress. Flat histories or implicit policy states may contain past observations, but they do not provide an explicit interface for deciding which world facts support the currently active goal. We introduce Mimir, a neuro-symbolic memory that separates world memory from task memory and dynamically grounds them before each action. World memory maintains object locations, object states, and perceptual evidence, while task memory maintains an ordered goal agenda, progress state, hand state, failures, and execution constraints. A grounding module binds the active goal to recalled world candidates, fills missing source locations, and attaches evidence before planning and embodiment-specific execution. Across tested backbones, Mimir consistently improves on different EB-ALFRED and EB-Habitat tasks, with maximum gains of 42.5% and average gains of 23.0%, respectively. Compared with the best results among prior agent and memory systems evaluated under the same backbone, Mimir improves the overall average success rate by 8.5%. Finally, on the EB-Habitat Long-horizon subset, Mimir achieves 86.0% success rate, substantially outperforming current closed-source models. Our code will be released soon.
tldr: Mimir is a neuro-symbolic memory system that separates world and task memory with dynamic grounding, improving long-horizon embodied task success rates on EB-ALFRED and EB-Habitat benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Mimir 是一种神经符号记忆系统，将世界记忆与任务记忆分离并动态接地，在 EB-ALFRED 和 EB-Habitat 基准测试中提升了长时域具身任务的成功率。
summary_zh: 长时域具身任务要求智能体在部分可观测条件下行动，同时保持对场景信念与执行进度的维护。平面化的历史记录或隐式策略状态虽能包含过往观测信息，却缺乏显式接口来判定哪些世界事实支撑当前活跃目标。我们提出Mimir——一种神经符号记忆体系，将世界记忆与任务记忆分离，并在每次动作前对二者进行动态接地。世界记忆维护物体位置、物体状态及感知证据，任务记忆则维护有序目标议程、进度状态、手部状态、失败记录及执行约束。接地模块将活跃目标与召回的世界候选对象绑定，补全缺失的源位置，并在规划与具身化执行之前附加证据。在测试的多种主干网络上，Mimir在EB-ALFRED与EB-Habitat任务中均实现持续改进，最高提升达42.5%，平均提升达23.0%。与基于相同主干网络评估的先前最优智能体及记忆系统相比，Mimir将总体平均成功率提升8.5%。最终，在EB-Habitat长时域子集上，Mimir达到86.0%的成功率，显著超越当前闭源模型。我们的代码将很快发布。

title: From Transparent Labware Segmentation to Collision Avoidance: A Real-Time Edge-Aware Perception Pipeline
summary: This paper presents an edge-aware instance segmentation framework that enables real-time robotic collision avoidance with transparent laboratory glassware using purely visual perception. Transparent vessels defy conventional segmentation due to refraction, specular reflection, and the absence of stable interior texture, yet their boundary contours remain comparatively reliable visual cues. Exploiting this observation, we augment a one-stage real-time instance segmentation backbone with a lightweight edge-detection branch, edge-guided attention fusion, and a parameter-free SimAM module, and further construct LabGlass-IS, a 3485-image, 21-category instance segmentation dataset of real laboratory glassware. The enhanced model achieves the highest Boundary F-score of 97.80 among compared methods, outperforming the YOLO-prompted FastSAM framework by 18.93 BF points. Furthermore, it maintains an inference speed of 7.1ms per frame and requires only 2.85% of the parameters of the closest accuracy competitor. Multi-view triangulation of mask centroids further provides 3D positions for conservative bounding-volume collision constraints. Real-robot trials achieve a 93.3% collision avoidance success rate, indicating the feasibility of the proposed perception-to-action pipeline for robot collision avoidance among fragile transparent objects. Our code is available at https://github.com/havishamy/TransYOLO_3D. Our video is available at https://havishamy.github.io/paper-videos/.
tldr: This paper presents a real-time edge-aware segmentation framework for transparent labware, enabling 3D collision avoidance with a 93.3% success rate on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向透明器皿的实时边缘感知分割框架，实现了三维碰撞避免，真实机器人避障成功率达93.3%。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种边缘感知的实例分割框架，该框架通过纯视觉感知实现了机器人在透明实验室玻璃器皿场景下的实时避碰。透明容器因折射、镜面反射以及缺乏稳定的内部纹理而难以进行常规分割，但其边界轮廓仍然是相对可靠的视觉线索。基于这一观察，我们为单阶段实时实例分割主干网络增加了轻量级边缘检测分支、边缘引导的注意力融合模块以及无参数的SimAM模块，并进一步构建了LabGlass-IS数据集——一个包含3485张图像、21个类别的真实实验室玻璃器皿实例分割数据集。增强后的模型在对比方法中取得了最高的边界F分数（97.80），比基于YOLO提示的FastSAM框架高出18.93个BF分数点。此外，该模型每帧推理速度仅为7.1毫秒，且参数量仅为精度最接近的对比方法的2.85%。通过多视角三角化计算掩膜质心，进一步提供了用于保守包围盒碰撞约束的三维位置信息。真实机器人实验实现了93.3%的避碰成功率，表明所提出的从感知到动作的处理流程在脆弱透明物体场景下的机器人避碰具有可行性。我们的代码已开源：https://github.com/havishamy/TransYOLO_3D，视频演示请见：https://havishamy.github.io/paper-videos/。

title: Suppression Sticks, Locality Is Fragile: A Closed-Loop Target-and-Control Audit of Task-Vector Negation in VLA Policies
summary: Task-vector arithmetic offers a closed-form way to modify a model, yet its behavioral locality remains unclear in closed-loop robot control. We present a target-and-control audit of per-skill task-vector subtraction from multitask vision-language-action (VLA) policies. Across all ten LIBERO-Goal skills, subtraction produces three qualitatively different regimes: target-control separation for five skills, resistance for three, and global collapse for two. On held-out initial states, the five suppressible targets remain at 0% success; however, mean baseline-normalized control retention is only 52%, and each target-suppressing edit materially harms at least one nominally unrelated control. Additional Goal panels show separation across tested policies with continuous-regression, discrete-token, and flow-matching action heads, whereas we observe no clean separation on Spatial and control collapse on the tested Object and Long-horizon panels. Mean task-vector cosine does not account for this variation. A matched-norm control identifies a local sign asymmetry around one Goal anchor, while multi-vector outcomes vary with anchor and scale. Retain-aware gradient baselines provide data-dependent comparators but require removal-time data and optimization; subtraction is data- and gradient-free only at edit time, assuming precomputed expert deltas. Finally, a single-skill relearning probe is consistent with behavioral masking, not certified unlearning. These results characterize task-vector subtraction as a fast but brittle intervention and underscore the need for closed-loop target-and-control evaluation when assessing locality in embodied model editing.
tldr: This paper audits task-vector subtraction in multitask VLA policies for closed-loop robot control, revealing brittleness and poor locality across different skills and policy architectures.
tldr_zh: 本文审计了多任务视觉-语言-动作策略中的任务向量减法，发现其在闭环机器人控制中脆弱且局部性差，不同技能和策略架构下表现不一。
summary_zh: 任务向量算术提供了一种修改模型的闭式方法，但其在闭环机器人控制中的行为局部性尚不明确。我们针对多任务视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中每项技能的向量减法操作，进行了目标与控制的审计。在所有十项LIBERO-Goal技能中，减法操作产生了三种性质不同的状态：五项技能出现目标-控制分离，三项表现出抗性，两项呈现全局崩溃。在未参与的初始状态下，五项可抑制目标仍保持0%成功率；然而，平均基线归一化控制保留率仅为52%，且每次抑制目标的编辑操作至少会严重损害一个名义上无关的控制任务。额外的目标面板显示，在采用连续回归、离散token和流匹配动作头的测试策略中均观察到这种分离，而在空间面板中未观察到清晰分离，在测试的对象和长周期面板中则观察到控制崩溃。平均任务向量余弦值无法解释这种变化。一个匹配范数控制揭示了围绕某个目标锚点的局部符号不对称性，而多向量结果则随锚点和尺度变化。保留感知梯度基线提供了依赖数据的比较器，但需要移除时刻的数据和优化；减法操作仅在编辑时刻免于数据和梯度，但需预设专家差分。最后，单技能重新学习探针与行为掩蔽一致，而非认证遗忘。这些结果将任务向量减法定性为一种快速但脆弱的干预手段，并强调在评估具身模型编辑的局部性时，需要进行闭环目标与控制评估。

title: Overcoming Statistical Bias in Action-Controllable World Models
summary: Action-conditioned world models aim to predict how visual environments evolve under an agent's actions. Yet future frames are often highly predictable from visual inertia and recurring motion patterns alone. This creates a shortcut: models can fit the data by exploiting statistical biases without making their visible dynamics meaningfully depend on the action. As a result, different actions may produce similar futures, while motion may persist even under zero action. The key question is how to reduce reliance on statistical shortcuts from dominating action-conditioned prediction. We argue that action control requires more than injecting action features; it requires enforcing consistency under counterfactual changes to actions and observations. Based on this insight, we introduce CoCo, a Counterfactual Consistency framework to enhance action controllability through two complementary constraints. Multi-step counterfactual consistency constrains reference, inverse-action, and zero-action rollouts, while action-spatial counterfactual consistency enforces consistent predictions under mirrored scenes and transformed actions. Together, they reduce reliance on statistical shortcuts from substituting for action-dependent dynamics. We further introduce Action Response Consistency (ARC) and Drift Energy (DE) to assess action controllability, together with Mini-SSMB for same-state, multi-action counterfactual evaluation. On Mini-SSMB, our full model achieved ARC_inv of 0.412 and ARC_ref of 0.483, while reducing DE by 17.07% relative to the baseline. On VP2 visual planning, it achieves the highest average success rate among SOTA models, at 73.1%. Experiments on BAIR and RoboNet further show that these gains preserve video prediction quality and transfer across model settings.
tldr: The paper introduces CoCo, a counterfactual consistency framework for action-conditioned world models that reduces reliance on statistical shortcuts by enforcing multi-step and action-spatial consistency, improving action controllability and achieving state-of-the-art results on visual planning and video prediction benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CoCo，一个用于动作条件世界模型的反事实一致性框架，通过多步和动作空间一致性约束减少对统计捷径的依赖，提升了动作可控性，并在视觉规划和视频预测基准上取得了最优结果。
summary_zh: 基于动作的条件世界模型旨在预测视觉环境在智能体动作作用下如何演化。然而，未来帧往往仅凭视觉惯性和重复运动模式就可高度预测。这导致一种捷径：模型可通过利用统计偏差来拟合数据，而无需使其可见动态切实依赖于动作。其结果是：不同动作可能产生相似的未来画面，甚至零动作状态下运动也可能持续存在。核心问题在于如何降低统计捷径对主导动作条件预测的影响。我们认为，动作控制不仅需要注入动作特征，更需要在动作与观测的反事实变化下强制执行一致性。基于这一见解，我们提出CoCo（反事实一致性框架），通过两种互补约束来增强动作可控性：多步反事实一致性约束参考轨迹、逆动作轨迹与零动作轨迹；动作空间反事实一致性则要求在镜像场景与变换动作下保持预测一致。二者协同作用，可减少对替代动作相关动态的统计捷径的依赖。我们进一步引入动作响应一致性（ARC）和漂移能量（DE）来评估动作可控性，并构建了用于同状态多动作反事实评估的Mini-SSMB基准。在Mini-SSMB上，我们的完整模型实现了0.412的ARC_inv与0.483的ARC_ref，同时相较基线降低了17.07%的DE。在VP2视觉规划任务中，该模型在最优模型中以73.1%的平均成功率领先。BAIR与RoboNet上的实验进一步表明，这些增益能保持视频预测质量，并可在不同模型设置间迁移。

title: GASP: GPU-Accelerated Safe Planner for Real-Time Collision-Aware Motion Generation with Latent Trajectory Sampling
summary: We present GASP, a GPU-Accelerated Safe Planner for real-time, collision-aware joint-space motion generation in known environments. GASP combines a clamped B-spline trajectory parameterization with a convolutional residual neural network that predicts the free interior control points, while analytically inserted boundary control points enforce initial and final derivative constraints for collision-aware planning under non-stationary conditions. A conditional variational autoencoder samples multiple trajectory candidates, which are decoded and validated in parallel on the GPU, yielding a batched planner for collision-aware coupled joint-space motion with near-millisecond inference. We validate GASP as an online motion-generation module, where it achieves analytical-level success rates with high collision-aware feasibility and substantially reduces inference time relative to GPU-based trajectory optimization. We further deploy GASP as a reinforcement-learning reset planner in competitive robotic table tennis, matching the baseline return rate while roughly halving training-time collisions.
tldr: GASP is a GPU-accelerated motion planner that uses B-spline parameterization and a neural network with CVAE to generate collision-free joint-space trajectories in real time, validated on a robotic table tennis reset planner.
tldr_zh: GASP 是一种利用 GPU 加速的运动规划器，通过 B 样条参数化、神经网络和条件变分自编码器实时生成无碰撞的关节空间轨迹，并在机器人乒乓球重置规划任务中验证。
summary_zh: 我们提出GASP，一种用于已知环境下实时、碰撞感知的关节空间运动生成的GPU加速安全规划器。GASP将夹紧B样条轨迹参数化与卷积残差神经网络相结合，该网络预测自由内部控制点，同时通过解析方式插入边界控制点来强制执行非平稳条件下碰撞感知规划的初始与末端导数约束。条件变分自编码器采样多个候选轨迹，这些轨迹在GPU上并行解码和验证，从而形成一种批处理规划器，用于碰撞感知的耦合关节空间运动，推理时间接近毫秒级。我们验证了GASP作为在线运动生成模块的性能：它实现了解析级的成功率，同时具有高碰撞感知可行性，并且相比基于GPU的轨迹优化显著减少了推理时间。我们进一步将GASP部署为竞技乒乓球领域中的强化学习重置规划器，在将训练期间碰撞次数大致减半的同时，保持了与基线相当的接球率。

title: SSC: A Verifiable Structured Representation for Bimanual Manipulation Labelling
summary: Subtask labels decompose a long-horizon manipulation demonstration into shorter semantic segments for policy training and evaluation. Natural language descriptions are easy to read, but their linguistic variability makes automatic verification difficult. Rigid template formats, such as BEHAVIOR-1K's skill_annotation, are linguistically over-segmented, hindering both readability and annotation consistency. We propose the Structured Subtask Chain (SSC), a state-transition representation that bridges these extremes. A demonstration is a sequence of Structured Subtask Template (SST) entries. Each SST stores core action components (subject, predicate, object), flexible conditions (adverbial modifiers such as spatial or instrumental phrases), a base-motion field separate from arm actions, and an after-state scene graph. Built on this format, SSC supports three vision-language assisted functions: rendering SSTs as natural language, checking the assembled chain against four state-transition rules, and completing underspecified fields through a query resolution cascade. We instantiate the pipeline on BEHAVIOR-1K (50 tasks, 3 episodes per task, 2,357 annotated action cells) for logic verification and content completion, evaluating 13 selected state-of-the-art VL models as candidate verifiers and reporting labelling anomalies.
tldr: Proposes Structured Subtask Chain (SSC), a state-transition representation for bimanual manipulation labeling that balances readability with automatic verifiability, and instantiates it on BEHAVIOR-1K with VL model-based verification.
tldr_zh: 提出结构化子任务链（SSC），一种用于双臂操作标注的状态转换表示，兼顾可读性与自动可验证性，并在BEHAVIOR-1K上结合VL模型验证实现。
summary_zh: 子任务标签将长时间跨度的操作演示分解为较短的语义片段，用于策略训练与评估。自然语言描述易于理解，但其语言变异性导致自动验证困难。BEHAVIOR-1K的skill_annotation等刚性模板格式在语言上过度分割，既降低了可读性又影响了标注一致性。我们提出结构化子任务链（SSC），这是一种介于上述两种极端方法之间的状态转移表示形式。演示被表示为一系列结构化子任务模板（SST）条目。每个SST存储核心动作组件（主体、谓词、客体）、灵活条件（如空间或工具短语等状语修饰语）、与手臂动作分离的基础运动字段，以及后置状态场景图。基于该格式，SSC支持三种视觉-语言辅助功能：将SST渲染为自然语言、依据四条状态转移规则检查已装配的链、通过查询解析级联完成未指定字段。我们在BEHAVIOR-1K（50个任务，每任务3段演示，2,357个已标注动作单元）上实例化该流程以进行逻辑验证与内容补全，评估了13个精选的最先进视觉-语言模型作为候选验证器，并报告了标注异常现象。

title: When Shared Rollouts Fail in Defensive Driving Evaluation: A NAVSIM Score Basis Audit
summary:
Defensive driving scores are useful only when they preserve distinctions between policies that observe surrounding actors and those that do not. Re-simulation benchmarks may use reference-conditioned forgiveness, under which an agent receives credit when the logged human reference fails a compliance channel. When agent and reference share an unstable rollout transformation, this rule can propagate shared reference failures into broad compliance credit.
  We audit this risk in NAVSIM v2.2 original scene single-stage scoring. Under the affected documented-stack condition on the audited numerical backend, the route-blind Ignore-All probe and a route-aware actor-blind probe outrank human replay and PDM-Closed over the complete 12,146-token navtest split. A fresh installation following the public specification reproduces rollout divergence on a fixed 32-token diagnostic set. A same-source dependency stack control and an exact-input diagnostic isolate dependency-sensitive numerical behavior in the shared velocity refit. On a 450-token control pool, replacing only the solver eliminates rollout divergence and restores blind-last ordering while keeping forgiveness enabled. Thus, the numerical instability is the direct trigger. Reference-conditioned forgiveness propagates the resulting shared reference failures into compliance credit. We contribute an audit protocol requiring score basis and stack disclosure, blind probes, overwrite reporting, and rollout stability tests before using such scores for defensive driving claims.
tldr: This paper audits NAVSIM v2.2 defensive driving scoring and identifies numerical instability in the shared velocity refit as the direct cause of rollout divergence, which together with reference-conditioned forgiveness can inflate compliance credit for blind probes and produce misleading rankings.
tldr_zh: 本文审计了NAVSIM v2.2防御性驾驶评分，发现共享速度重拟合中的数值不稳定性是导致轨迹发散的直接原因，该不稳定性与参考条件宽恕机制相结合，会使盲探针获得虚假合规信用并产生误导性排名。
summary_zh:
防御性驾驶评分仅在能够区分观察周围交通参与者的策略与未观察的策略时才有价值。重模拟基准测试可能采用参考条件化宽容机制，即当记录的人类参考在合规通道上失败时，智能体可获得信用分。当智能体与参考共享不稳定的展开变换时，该规则可能将共享的参考失败传播为广泛的合规信用分。

我们在NAVSIM v2.2原始场景单阶段评分中审计了这一风险。在受影响的有文档记录的堆栈条件下（基于被审计的数值后端），路线盲视的忽略一切探测器和路线感知的行为盲探测器，在完整的12,146条navtest数据分割上超越了人类回放和PDM-Closed。根据公开规范进行全新安装后，在固定32条数据诊断集上重现了展开发散。同源依赖堆栈对照与精确输入诊断，在共享速度重构中定位了依赖敏感的数值行为。在450条数据对照池中，仅替换求解器即可消除展开发散，并在保持宽容机制启用状态下恢复盲探测器的末位排序。因此，数值不稳定性是直接诱因。参考条件化宽容机制将由此产生的共享参考失败传播为合规信用分。我们贡献了一套审计协议，要求在使用此类评分进行防御性驾驶声明之前，必须公开评分依据与堆栈信息、使用盲探测器、进行覆盖报告以及展开稳定性测试。

title: Radar4D-VLM: Proposal-Grounded Temporal 4D Radar Reasoning Across Frozen Language Models
summary: Vision-language models for autonomous driving primarily rely on cameras and LiDAR, leaving 4D radar largely unexplored as a standalone perceptual modality despite its robustness to adverse visibility and direct measurement of radial velocity. We introduce Radar4D-VLM, a radar-only temporal vision-language model that reasons from ten consecutive 4D-radar point-cloud sweeps without camera or LiDAR input. Radar4D-VLM extracts geometrically grounded object proposals and organizes radar evidence into a compact hierarchy of object, scene, and kinematic tokens. A parameter-efficient projector maps these tokens into frozen language backbones, while auditable prediction heads jointly model object count, spatial distribution, motion state, collision risk, semantic category, and radial velocity. Radar4D-VLM combines proposal-grounded temporal object tokenization, global scene context, and explicit kinematic tokens within a unified frozen-backbone interface. On sequence-isolated K-Radar development validation, its Top-64 proposal recall reaches 98.13% at 4 m, exceeding fixed-lattice and uniform-random controls by 6.40 and 22.83 percentage points, respectively. We further evaluate 24 matched runs spanning eight frozen Qwen, Phi, Mistral, Llama, and Gemma backbones under an identical adaptation budget. The radar-token interface remains compatible across all five language-model families, while matched aligned, permuted, and no-language controls show sensor dependence but no stable direct-head gain from aligned language supervision. These results establish a reproducible foundation for radar-only multimodal scene and motion reasoning while separating interface compatibility from the benefit of language supervision.
tldr: Radar4D-VLM proposes a radar-only temporal VLM for autonomous driving that extracts grounded object proposals from 4D radar sweeps and reasons about scenes and kinematics via frozen LLM backbones, achieving high recall on K-Radar benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Radar4D-VLM 提出了一种仅使用4D雷达的时序视觉语言模型，用于自动驾驶，从雷达点云中提取对象提案并通过冻结的大语言模型进行场景与运动推理，在K-Radar基准上实现了高召回率。
summary_zh: 面向自动驾驶的视觉-语言模型主要依赖摄像头与激光雷达，而4D雷达尽管具有对恶劣可见度的鲁棒性及可直接测量径向速度的优势，但其作为独立感知模态的研究仍基本处于空白。我们提出Radar4D-VLM——一种纯雷达时序视觉-语言模型，该模型仅基于连续十帧4D雷达点云扫描进行推理，无需摄像头或激光雷达输入。Radar4D-VLM提取具有几何基础的物体提案，并将雷达证据组织成紧凑的层级结构，包含物体、场景与运动学三类令牌。通过参数高效的投影器将这些令牌映射至冻结的语言骨干网络，同时可审计预测头联合建模物体数量、空间分布、运动状态、碰撞风险、语义类别及径向速度。Radar4D-VLM在统一的冻结骨干网络接口中融合了基于提案的时序物体令牌化、全局场景上下文以及显式运动学令牌。在序列隔离的K-Radar开发验证集上，其Top-64提案召回率在4米范围内达到98.13%，分别超过固定网格与均匀随机基线6.40和22.83个百分点。我们进一步在相同的适配预算下，对涵盖Qwen、Phi、Mistral、Llama与Gemma五种冻结骨干网络的24组匹配实验进行评估。雷达令牌接口在所有五个语言模型家族中均保持兼容性，而匹配的对齐、置换及无语言控制实验表明存在传感器依赖性，但未发现对齐语言监督带来的稳定直接性能增益。这些结果为纯雷达多模态场景与运动推理建立了可复现的基础，同时将接口兼容性与语言监督的收益分离。

title: Toward Integrating Adaptive Experience Replay and Online Uncertainty Estimation in Safe Actor-Critic Optimal Control
summary: Safe actor-critic control often treats barrier filtering, uncertainty estimation, and experience replay as separate modules, even though each changes the data used for learning and control. We develop an integrated architecture in which the uncertainty estimate updates the obstacle geometry used by a control barrier function, filter interventions and estimation residuals determine replay priority, and the critic learns from the executed rather than nominal action. We instantiate the architecture on a two-dimensional robot-navigation task with corrupted obstacle measurements and compare six component-matched configurations under common training budgets, random seeds, sensor streams, exploration, and disturbances. Evaluation includes a moderate post-training test, an eleven-level perception-noise sweep, and an exploratory extreme-stress test at multiplier $6.0$. In the extreme test, the integrated configuration recorded no contacts and reached the goal in all five evaluation seeds. Its mean cost was $7.63\pm0.44$ and its obstacle-belief root-mean-square error was $3.52\pm0.55$ cm. The uncertainty-estimation ablation also recorded no contacts but reached the goal in four of five seeds, with mean cost $8.96\pm2.08$ and belief error $11.08\pm1.23$ cm. A finite-training bound clarifies replay exposure, and a robust barrier condition states the required estimation-error and feasibility assumptions. The results support coupling estimation, safety filtering, and replay on this benchmark; broader safety and convergence claims require further study.
tldr: The paper proposes an integrated safe actor-critic architecture that couples uncertainty estimation, control barrier functions, and experience replay for robot navigation, demonstrating reduced collisions and lower belief error in extreme noise tests.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种集成的安全演员-评论家架构，将不确定性估计、控制障碍函数和体验回放耦合，用于机器人导航，在极端噪声测试中展示了减少碰撞和更低信念误差的效果。
summary_zh: 安全演员-评论家控制通常将障碍滤波、不确定性估计和经验回放视为独立模块，尽管每个模块都会改变学习和控制所使用的数据。我们开发了一种集成架构，其中不确定性估计更新控制障碍函数所使用的障碍几何形状，滤波干预和估计残差决定回放优先级，且评论家从实际执行的行动而非名义行动中学习。我们在一个含有噪声障碍测量的二维机器人导航任务上实例化了该架构，并在共同训练预算、随机种子、传感器数据流、探索和干扰条件下比较了六种组件匹配的配置。评估包括中等强度训练后测试、十一级感知噪声扫描以及乘数$6.0$下的探索性极端压力测试。在极端测试中，集成配置在所有五个评估种子中均未发生接触并到达目标，其平均成本为$7.63\pm0.44$，障碍信念均方根误差为$3.52\pm0.55$厘米。不确定性估计消融实验也未发生接触，但在五个种子中有四个到达目标，平均成本为$8.96\pm2.08$，信念误差为$11.08\pm1.23$厘米。一个有限训练界限阐明了回放暴露问题，一个鲁棒障碍条件陈述了所需的估计误差和可行性假设。结果支持在该基准上将估计、安全滤波和回放进行耦合；更广泛的安全性和收敛性声明需要进一步研究。

title: Differential 6-DOF Pose Estimation with Provable First-Order Immunity to Camera Calibration Errors
summary: Accurate six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) motion estimation is essential for robotic manipulation, autonomous systems, and structural displacement monitoring. Conventional 3D-2D methods estimate absolute camera poses independently at each time and recover platform motion through camera-to-platform extrinsics, making them sensitive to extrinsic calibration errors, especially for micromotion. We present a differential pose estimation method that directly recovers platform motion from inter-frame image displacements and known 3D control points. By differencing perspective projection equations, using a depth-invariance approximation, and modeling motion on SE(3), the method avoids independent absolute-pose estimation and supports both monocular and multi-camera systems. We prove that translational extrinsic errors cancel exactly, while rotational errors induce a bounded perturbation determined by calibration error, motion magnitude, and observation geometry. We also derive generic observability conditions, a Cramer-Rao lower bound, and a bias-eliminated consistent estimator, and characterize the validity limits of the approximations. Extensive synthetic and real-world experiments establish a new state of the art for 6-DOF platform micromotion estimation, outperforming representative PnP and generalized-PnP methods in accuracy, calibration robustness, and computational efficiency. With five control points and 0.5-pixel image noise, the monocular solver obtains a combined pitch-yaw rotation RMSE of 10.09 arcsec, a translation RMSE of 3.70 mm, and a runtime of 0.34 ms. The binocular solver achieves a rotation RMSE of 10.58 arcsec, a translation RMSE of 3.91 mm, and a runtime of 0.27 ms. Code will be released upon publication at https://github.com/zyoungszu/pami2026.
tldr: This paper proposes a differential 6-DOF pose estimation method that directly recovers platform motion from inter-frame image displacements, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and robustness to extrinsic calibration errors for micromotion, with applications in robotic manipulation and autonomous systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种差分六自由度位姿估计方法，通过帧间图像位移直接恢复平台运动，在微运动场景下实现了对相机外参标定误差的鲁棒性，并达到最先进的精度，适用于机器人操作和自主系统。
summary_zh: 精确的六自由度运动估计对于机器人操控、自主系统及结构位移监测至关重要。传统的3D-2D方法独立估计每个时刻的绝对相机位姿，并通过相机到平台的标定参数恢复平台运动，这使得其对标定误差（尤其是微运动情况下的误差）非常敏感。本文提出一种差分位姿估计方法，直接从帧间图像位移和已知的3D控制点恢复平台运动。通过微分透视投影方程、采用深度不变性近似以及在SE(3)上建模运动，该方法避免了独立的绝对位姿估计，并同时支持单目和多相机系统。我们证明了平移外参误差会被完全抵消，而旋转误差仅产生一个由标定误差、运动幅度和观测几何决定的有限扰动。此外，我们推导了通用可观测性条件、克拉美-罗下界以及一种消除偏差的一致性估计器，并刻画了近似方法的有效极限。大量仿真与真实世界实验为六自由度平台微运动估计建立了新的最优水平，在精度、标定鲁棒性和计算效率方面均优于代表性的PnP和广义PnP方法。使用五个控制点和0.5像素图像噪声时，单目求解器在俯仰-偏航联合旋转上的均方根误差为10.09角秒，平移均方根误差为3.70毫米，运行时间为0.34毫秒；双目求解器的旋转均方根误差为10.58角秒，平移均方根误差为3.91毫米，运行时间为0.27毫秒。代码将于论文发表后公开在 https://github.com/zyoungszu/pami2026。

title: Structured LLM Reasoning for Zero-Shot Human--Robot Coordination Under Hidden Goals
summary: We present a structured large-language-model (LLM) architecture for zero-shot human--robot coordination in a cooperative construction task with private goal views. Guided by a Dec-POMDP formulation, the architecture decomposes decision-making into (i) action-conditioned Theory-of-Mind (ToM) inference, (ii) hierarchical planning, (iii) conversation interpretation, (iv) action verification, and (v) feedback-based replanning. We compare the proposed method with an ablation without ToM inference and a multi-agent reinforcement-learning policy trained offline over many goal pairs. In human-participant experiments, the proposed method required fewer interaction steps and yielded higher post-interaction trust ratings than both baselines.
